summary: Iteration 5 backend testing complete: 16/16 pytest cases pass. Verified user's core complaint (broken images + stale news) is FIXED. GET /api/feuds returns 14 feuds; every one has a non-null image_url and every image_url returns HTTP 2xx (verified with HEAD/GET follow-redirects, UA=Mozilla). No two feuds share the same sources[0].link (dedup working). All 7 categories return >=1 feud via /api/feuds?category=<id>. Freshness: 6/7 categories have an AI-generated feud in the last 24h (politica, tv, musica, sport, social, gossip); cinema is legitimately stale (seed only) — acceptable per spec. POST /api/admin/generate-daily?count=1 returns 200 in ~7-10s and, when it creates a feud, that feud has non-empty sources and a reachable image_url. Regression pass: /api/search?q=Ferragni returns 200 with list body, /api/share/{id} returns {feud:{...}}, /api/share/{id}/html returns text/html with og:title/og:image/og:url/twitter:card. Notable observation: sport AI feud now uses a native Gazzetta.it hero image (https://www.gazzetta.it/methode_image/...) instead of a fallback Unsplash, confirming _image_from_entry is correctly extracting hero images from RSS enclosures.
critical_code_review_comments: Two older AI feuds (musica feud_f6777ab917cd, social feud_75fd7aff892f, both from 2026-07-10T11:33) have empty sources — likely generated before the sources-persistence fix. They are excluded from the dedup check (skipped when sources[0].link is missing). Non-blocking but consider a one-off backfill or letting the 3-day rotation replace them.

Cinema still has only a seed feud (no fresh AI). Spec explicitly allows this if today's RSS pool wasn't juicy enough; scheduler will retry next hour. Monitor in 24-48h to confirm BadTaste+ANSA cinema feeds actually yield entries.
_image_for_category fallback IDs are working — all 12 Unsplash URLs used across the 14 feuds returned 2xx. Good.
_image_from_entry correctly used for sport (gazzetta.it hero) — the RSS enclosure extraction path is exercised in production.
server.py is ~980 lines (per prior iteration); still would benefit from modularization but not blocking.

Consider adding an admin cleanup endpoint (or one-shot script) to purge the 7 seed feuds now that the AI pipeline is healthy — they're duplicating category slots and were flagged in the RCA as visual noise for users.
seed_data_creation: test_admin_generate_daily_still_works may add up to 1 new AI feud. No other test data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 confirms the image + freshness bug fix. Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_news_freshness_images.py — reusable, uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env (defaults to team-pick.preview.emergentagent.com). It parametrizes over 7 categories, does live HTTP HEAD/GET on every image_url, dedup check on sources[0].link, and 24h freshness check on source='ai' feuds. If future changes add more feuds, the count assertion allows 12-20 slack. Note: 2 old AI feuds have empty sources (musica feud_f6777ab917cd, social feud_75fd7aff892f from 2026-07-10T11:33Z) — dedup test skips them intentionally. Cinema has no AI feud today — allowed per spec.
rca_of_issue: Original bug (broken images + stale news across categories) is verified fixed at HTTP level. All 14 image_url values return 2xx; dedup by source link is enforced; 6/7 categories have <24h-fresh AI content; on-demand generation still produces valid feuds with sources and working images. No further action needed on the backend.
